## Scope

The quality audit covered a sample of 475 graded sets. Each set was read again by a second grader to assess the consistency of the original grading. The second reading provided a basis for comparing the first and second grades across the sample. This review was intended to identify the level of agreement between graders and to support routine quality monitoring.

## Result

The first and second grades agreed in 71.8 per cent of sets. This result indicates the overall level of agreement observed in the reviewed sample. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet. The results are also discussed privately with each grader to support review of individual findings and any follow-up required.
